# YRVAAN GeoSystems

> Specialist geotechnical contractor in India delivering earth retention and substructure works — soldier pile walls, diaphragm walls, shotcreting, and engineered retention systems.

YRVAAN GeoSystems Pvt Ltd designs and executes deep-excavation support and substructure packages for infrastructure, commercial, and industrial projects.
